run_gen_actions_csv: run gen_actions.py to generate a CSV of StarCraft II ability definitions
run_gen_actions_python: run gen_actions.py to generate Python action function definitions for actions.py
generate_csv_abilities: generate a CSV of StarCraft II game abilities with id, name, hotkey, and mismatch info
generate_py_abilities: generate Python action function definitions from StarCraft II ability data
get_game_data: retrieve static ability data from a running StarCraft II game instance
